items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And I sent out and got Snake White as trumpeter, my friend, and he came and played trumpet.

ctx.x: But anyway, we played -- I put this band together and Les Hite was playing at the SEBASTIAN'S Cotton Club. And I used to rehearse over to at the union and I knew Lionel, used to come down there. I used to write somethings for him when he had his band. Then he went into the Cotton Club with his band. He had Herschel Evans and a bunch of follows with him out at the Cotton Club.

So we played around down to -- in California, San Bernadino. I met a man there and he put my band out in San Bernadino. And I had me, there was me and Don Byas, Jack McVee was playing and Paul Howard and Hugo Dandridge. That was the saxophone section. And I sent out and got Snake White as trumpeter, my friend, and he came and played trumpet. And I had a fellow named Red Mack on trumpet and another fellow named Peewee Brice on trumpet. Then I had -- Al Morgan came to play bass with me and I had Dudley Brooks on…
Did you have Duke Brooks later? Do I remember Duke Brooks?
